{{Quote|If we do this&hellip; our best access point is the laser drill shaft where the isotope-5 was originally discovered. The shaft runs kilometers under a mining station, and it's been abandoned&mdash;so probably treacherous, but less chance of Hutt interference.|Katha Niar|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''abandoned mining mesa''' was the site of a [[Mining/Legends|mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Makeb]]. It was here that [[isotope-5]] was first discovered by [[Solida Hesk's mining corporation]], but the mesa was abandoned due to safety concerns and was overrun by native wildlife.<ref name="TOR" />
